categories.main_business_segments: Hirogin Holdings operates primarily in three business segments: banking (centered on Hiroshima Bank), leasing (through Hirogin Lease), and other financial services including securities, credit guarantees, consulting, IT solutions, credit cards, and asset management. The banking segment is the core, providing deposit, lending, securities investment, and foreign exchange services. The group also includes subsidiaries and affiliates engaged in securities brokerage, credit services, IT, and consulting.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The group leverages advanced banking IT systems, including participation in the MEJAR next-generation core banking system, and emphasizes digital transformation (DX) through AI, digital channels, and data utilization. Risk management, compliance, and integrated group governance are supported by robust internal controls and digital infrastructure. The group also develops specialized financial products such as sustainable finance and consulting services for regional revitalization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individuals and corporations in the Chugoku and Shikoku regions, especially Hiroshima, Okayama, Yamaguchi, and Ehime prefectures. The group serves a broad range of industries, with a focus on local manufacturing, retail, real estate, and public sector clients. It also targets SMEs, local governments, and individual retail banking customers, while expanding solutions for startups and overseas business support.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in western Japan, particularly Hiroshima and neighboring prefectures (Okayama, Yamaguchi, Ehime), with a branch network extending to major Japanese cities (Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Kobe, Fukuoka, etc.). Overseas presence is limited but includes a Singapore-based consulting subsidiary to support clients' international business.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hirogin Holdings is positioned downstream in the financial services supply chain, directly interfacing with end customers (individuals, corporations, and public entities) as a provider of banking, leasing, and financial solutions. It also acts as a financial intermediary and service aggregator for regional economic development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include regional revitalization, digital transformation (DX), sustainability (SX), and alliances (AX) with other financial and non-financial institutions. The group is investing in IT systems, human capital, and new business models, with a strong focus on ESG, DE&I, and supporting the transition to a carbon-neutral society. R&D is oriented toward developing new financial products, digital services, and consulting solutions for local businesses.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily from interest income on loans, fees from financial services (including leasing, securities, and consulting), and investment income from securities. Additional revenue streams include credit card fees, IT solutions, and trust/asset management services. Dividend income from subsidiaries is also a significant source for the holding company.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include regional banks, megabanks, and other financial institutions operating in western Japan, as well as non-bank financial service providers and digital platformers. Hirogin Holdings is positioned as a leading regional financial group with a strong local presence and diversified service offerings, facing increasing competition from both traditional banks and fintech entrants.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated ordinary income was ¥201.4 billion, with ordinary profit of ¥52.2 billion and net income attributable to parent shareholders of ¥35.8 billion, marking record-high profits. Total assets stood at ¥12.1 trillion, with a workforce of 3,689 employees. The group has shown steady revenue and profit growth over recent years, supported by increased lending, improved margins, and cost control.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hirogin Holdings differentiates itself as a 'regional comprehensive service group' deeply committed to local economic development and customer-centric solutions. Its value proposition centers on integrated financial and non-financial services, digital innovation, sustainability leadership, and strong regional relationships. The group emphasizes personalized consulting, support for regional businesses, and a holistic approach to community and stakeholder engagement.
